title: Reasoning from stated conditions
bodyMd: A service enrolled 200 customers in January and 100 in February. After the same three-month follow-up, 150 January customers and 80 February customers remained. No revenue figures are provided.
accessibilityText: Read the accompanying original prose passage. All information needed for the questions is in the passage.
